rows.label: Basic tariff: taxable income above CHF 780,440
rows.note: t) 11,0 % für das gesamte steuerbare Einkommen, wenn dieses Fr. 716 000.– (780 440.–)* übersteigt.
rows.source_title: ESTV Kantonsblatt Graubünden (Stand: Februar 2026), Einkommenssteuer: Steuerberechnung, Art. 39 StG

rows.section: Multipliers 2026: canton, cantonal capital (Chur; other communes differ) and church tax
rows.label: Cantonal multiplier (multiple of the simple tax)
rows.note: Total income tax = simple tax × (cantonal + communal + church multiplier); church tax only for members. The communal and church figures are those of the cantonal capital, Chur; other communes in Graubünden set their own multipliers. Multiples as listed by the ESTV (1.19 = 119%).
rows.source_title: ESTV: Steuerfüsse der Kantonshauptorte 1995 - 2026 der natürlichen Personen (XLSX, sheet NP 2026; updated 14 September 2026)

rows.section: Multipliers 2026: canton, cantonal capital (Chur; other communes differ) and church tax
rows.label: Communal multiplier: Chur (cantonal capital; other communes differ)
rows.value: 88% of the cantonal tax at 100% (ESTV note 7)
rows.note: Total income tax = simple tax × (cantonal + communal + church multiplier); church tax only for members. The communal and church figures are those of the cantonal capital, Chur; other communes in Graubünden set their own multipliers. Multiples as listed by the ESTV (1.19 = 119%).

rows.section: Corporate profit tax 2026 (Graubünden)
rows.label: Profit tax rate
rows.note: The federal profit tax of 8.5% comes on top (national page). Simple rates are multiplied by the cantonal and communal multipliers where a canton uses them; each canton may raise the rate for companies in international groups where a foreign state requires a minimum tax.
rows.source_title: ESTV Kantonsblatt Graubünden (Stand Februar 2026), Juristische Personen: Steuerberechnung, Art. 87 StG

rows.section: Property tax: Liegenschaftssteuer (Graubünden)
rows.label: Who levies it
rows.value: Municipalities, optionally, in a formal municipal law
rows.note: An annual tax on the gross value of real estate (no debt deduction), separate from the wealth tax. Rates in per mille are shown as percentages (1.5 per mille = 0.15%).
rows.source_title: ESTV Steuermäppchen Liegenschaftssteuer: Besteuerung der Liegenschaften (tax period 2025, document dated 26.11.2025)

rows.section: Property tax: Liegenschaftssteuer (Graubünden)
rows.label: Maximum rate
rows.note: An annual tax on the gross value of real estate (no debt deduction), separate from the wealth tax. Rates in per mille are shown as percentages (1.5 per mille = 0.15%).
rows.source_title: ESTV Steuermäppchen Liegenschaftssteuer: Besteuerung der Liegenschaften (tax period 2025, document dated 26.11.2025)

rows.section: Property transfer tax: Handänderungssteuer (Graubünden)
rows.label: Who levies it
rows.value: Municipalities only (the canton levies none); each municipality sets its rate in a formal municipal law
rows.note: A tax on the transfer of ownership of real estate, separate from the property gains tax (Grundstückgewinnsteuer) on the seller's gain.
rows.source_title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Handänderungssteuer (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2022, November 2022)

rows.section: Property transfer tax: Handänderungssteuer (Graubünden)
rows.label: Maximum rate set by the canton
rows.note: ESTV, legislation as of 1 January 2022; Chur: 2%
rows.source_title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Handänderungssteuer (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2022, November 2022)
